name: strata
description: Persistent memory for AI assistants — runs locally on your machine. Remember every decision, debugging session, architecture debate, and project context across sessions. One MCP server, zero cloud dependencies, works on a Raspberry Pi. Your AI finally remembers what you talked about yesterday.

strata_url.description: Your Strata server URL (e.g. http://localhost:4320/mcp for a local install, or https://your-strata.example.com/mcp for a remote one)

strata_api_key.description: Your Strata agent API key. Create one at http://your-strata-server/admin/agents and paste it here. This is how Strata tracks which agent is talking to it and applies per-agent permissions.
